description: REQUIRES prior shinhan_easy__auth__id_password_session__login call with same account_link_id. Search Shinhan easy-inquiry transaction history for one account. Files: a document generated from this result, as Excel (xlsx) only when requested in output_formats, listed in artifacts[] of the result with a download_url that works for 15 minutes; each file is kept for 7 days. If a link has expired, call xdata__job__result with the job_id from the result for fresh links. Send exactly one of bank_account_credential_id (one account), bank_account_credential_ids (several accounts) or all_accounts (every account). 계좌마다 사용 토큰이 하나씩 듭니다. 기업정보 브리프처럼 한 번에 여러 사용 토큰을 쓰는 업무는 그 값만큼 계좌마다 듭니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

all_accounts.description: Set to true to run this once for every account registered for this bank. Each account is handled separately and uses the tokens this action costs. Send exactly one of bank_account_credential_id (one account), bank_account_credential_ids (several accounts) or all_accounts (every account).

bank_account_credential_id.description: Opaque bank-account credential selected by the user

bank_account_credential_ids.description: bank_account_credential_id values from this bank's accounts list tool. Runs this once for each listed account. Each account is handled separately and uses the tokens this action costs. Send exactly one of bank_account_credential_id (one account), bank_account_credential_ids (several accounts) or all_accounts (every account).

max_pages.description: Maximum pages to fetch; default 20, max 100

output_formats.description: Optional. Also return this result as a file (Excel (xlsx)) in artifacts[] of the result. Omit it for data only.

sort_order.description: Order of the returned transactions by date; desc is newest first (default), asc is oldest first.

name: shinhan_easy__accounts__transaction_history__search
